subject.title: Improve macOS onboarding UX and gateway setup

question: Should this protected-label PR be closed as superseded by current main, or should the contributor rebase and narrow it to a remaining onboarding polish change?
rationale: The central behavior is now covered by merged maintainer work, but the protected label and remaining security/auth findings require a maintainer choice rather than automated cleanup.

options.title: Close as superseded
options.body: Close this PR in favor of the current main onboarding implementation and ask for a fresh narrow PR only if a unique polish item remains.

options.title: Require a narrow rebase
options.body: Ask the contributor to rebase on current main, remove superseded flow changes, fix the security/auth findings, and add real macOS proof.

options.title: Adopt manually
options.body: A maintainer can take over the branch, but must first resolve the credentialed probe, acknowledgement bypass, and auth compatibility risks.

recommendation.title: Close as superseded
recommendation.body: Close this PR in favor of the current main onboarding implementation and ask for a fresh narrow PR only if a unique polish item remains.
